text:
alex: hey team :wave: finishing up my first-week checklist. i followed the quickstart but can't find the 'prod latency by route' Grafana panel anymore — links in the README 404. anyone know where that lives now? /cc @mira

devex-bot: Welcome to Redwood! If you need access to observability tools, run `open-access-request` or ping #devex.

mira: hi alex — welcome! :smile: The latency panel moved under Dashboards -> Observability -> 'API Latency (v2)'. old quickstart links are outdated. i can add you now if you tell me your @redwood email. the Datadog log link is stale; we switched orgs last month. use the new logs URL: https://app.datadoghq.com/logs?query=service:api (you may need the "observer" role)

alex: alex@redwood.com — thanks. i clicked the grafana link and got a 403. is there a quick way to request edit/view perms?

mira: i just sent you view+snapshot perms for Grafana. to request permanent edit access, open an access ticket at https://access.redwood.com and choose "Grafana - edit". if you're in a hurry i can grant temporarily.

samir: fwiw if you want to embed a single panel into Notion or docs, do: Dashboard -> Panel -> Share -> "Embed" -> copy the iframe/snippet. For snapshots use "Snapshot -> External link" so it doesn't require internal auth.

alex: tried the embed flow, iframe gives an auth wall. snapshot worked though. thanks! any keyboard shortcuts for navigating dashboards quickly?

samir: yeah, quick ones: press `g` then `d` to open dashboards, `/` to search, `s` for share on a panel. there's a small help menu in the bottom-left of Grafana with full list.

mira: also if you need alerts/monitors access in Datadog let me know — alert creation is restricted to SRE+owners. for viewing metrics you should be set.

alex: mira, i still see 403 on one dashboard (Observability -> Traces). could that be a nested-permission thing?

mira: ah yep — traces dashboards are in a separate team org. i'll add you to the obs-team group which should fix it. giving you a heads up in ~5m when it's done.

devex-bot: access request processed for alex (grafana:view, snapshot).

mira: done — alex, you should have access now. can you confirm?

alex: confirmed, can view traces + latency panel. huge help, thank you!! :raised_hands:

samir: welcome aboard. if you want a short demo of the common dashboards i can hop on a quick 15m call later today.

alex: yes please — 3pm works for me.

mira: i'll send a calendar invite. again welcome :tada:
